title: Graze values
description: The file game/tuning/scoring.json: the values a run pays and shows grazes with, read in both run modes. DRA-117. The file must exist; every field is optional, and a field left out keeps its default from core.graze (the DEFAULT_GRAZE_* constants, each the GDD's value). {} is a valid file. Key names are the GDD's key with the part of a compound key after it (06-scoring.md, Values: graze_points, graze_popup, graze_ring). The graze margin is not here: it is a value every hazard shares, in hazards.json. The two graze colors are not here: like every placeholder color they are view constants. Loaded and checked by game/app/tuning.py at startup (docs/contracts/systems/app/tuning-loader.md) into core.graze.GrazeRules. Owner of the schema: architect. Contract: docs/contracts/systems/run.md, Rules (step 5b, Score).

graze_points.description: Points one graze adds to the score, and the number its popup shows. Default: 06-scoring.md, graze_points (locked). Maps to GrazeRules.points.

graze_popup_ticks.description: States a graze popup shows on before it is gone, ticks. Default: 06-scoring.md, graze_popup (guess). Maps to GrazeRules.popup_ticks.

graze_popup_rise_per_tick.description: Px a graze popup rises up the screen each tick. An int or a float, never a bool. Default: 06-scoring.md, graze_popup (guess). Maps to GrazeRules.popup_rise_per_tick.

graze_ring_ticks.description: States a graze ring shows on while it grows and fades, ticks. Default: 06-scoring.md, graze_ring (guess). Maps to GrazeRules.ring_ticks.

graze_ring_start_diameter.description: Px across a graze ring is on the state it appears. An int or a float, never a bool. Default: 06-scoring.md, graze_ring (guess). Maps to GrazeRules.ring_start_diameter.

graze_ring_end_diameter.description: Px across a graze ring grows toward, reached as it fades out. An int or a float, never a bool. Default: 06-scoring.md, graze_ring (guess). Maps to GrazeRules.ring_end_diameter.

graze_ring_width.description: Line width of a graze ring, px. Default: 06-scoring.md, graze_ring (guess). Maps to GrazeRules.ring_width.
